description: The same mismatch, hidden behind the spec's Base64 sentinel encoding. A defender that compares the raw header string to the body value sees no mismatch. The spec requires decoding before comparison, so a correct defender still catches it.

expected.signal: Base64-sentinel Mcp-Name decodes to a value that does not match params.name; reject with -32020
expected.rationale: streamable-http §Value Encoding: servers MUST decode an encoded Mcp-Name or Mcp-Param-{Name} value before comparing it to the body value. Raw string comparison is a spec-defined blind spot.

provenance: synthetic — the sentinel format and the MUST-decode-before-compare rule are both specified in streamable-http §Value Encoding
